description: This source file defines enums, structs, and functions related to probing and handling remote gateway connections and authentication issues in a macOS application for the OpenClaw project.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayAuthIssue
classes.description: Enum representing various authentication issues encountered when connecting to a remote gateway, including error initialization and UI help properties.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeResult
classes.description: Enum representing the result of a probe attempt, indicating success, specific auth issues, or failure with message.

classes.name: RemoteGatewayProbeSuccess
classes.description: Struct containing details about a successful connection, including the authentication source and descriptive title/body.

methods.name: RemoteGatewayProbe.run
methods.description: Asynchronous static method to perform a probe of the remote gateway, handling different transport types, validating URLs, SSH, and returning a result.

methods.name: isValidWsUrl
methods.description: Private static method to validate WebSocket URLs for remote hosts.

methods.name: sshCheckCommand
methods.description: Private static method to generate an SSH command with options to check SSH connectivity to a target.

methods.name: formatSSHFailure
methods.description: Private static method to format error messages from SSH command responses.
